args.rationale: The report is tightly focused on NVDA at 2026-08-27 and correctly anchors on the frozen close of 227.98. Earnings figures are quoted exactly as in the official source (FQ2 2027, revenue $96.2B +18% q/q +106% y/y, Data Center $89.0B +117% y/y, GM 75.0% both bases, GAAP EPS 2.46 / non-GAAP 2.22). Critically, the report explicitly labels EPS as quarterly and repeatedly refuses to compute a trailing P/E, stating TTM EPS is UNKNOWN — this satisfies the semantic validity gate. Technical claims (10-EMA 217.08, MACD 2.68/signal 3.22, RSI 53.50, Bollinger 231.57, ATR 6.51) match the observed tool outputs, and the report correctly reports 50/200 SMA as NO_DATA_AVAILABLE rather than fabricating them. Derived arithmetic (8.7% gap, 1.66x volume, 92.5% DC concentration, 1.18^4−1) is transparently labeled as calc from sourced operands and checks out. Minor deductions: one bracketed citation uses a non-source tag ([NO_DATA_AVAILABLE]) instead of a source ID, and several historical price levels (209.66, 225.16, 208.48, 214.5) are used without explicit source tags though they are present in the frozen CSV. No key fabrication, no period/unit error, no unsupported valuation multiple.
